About RaggieSoft Backstage & Reader Bonus Features

Every Ocean View Archives novel stays faithful to its narrator’s lived point of view—such as Michael’s first-person narration in The Rachel Narrative, Nathaniel Prairie’s first-person perspective in Katie & Nathaniel, or Jordan’s close third-person point of view in The Eleventh Child. Housing hallway briefings, closed-door meetings, and staff dispatches inside RaggieSoft Backstage protects chapter immersion while rewarding curious readers with the full story behind the curtain.

Whenever a chapter on RaggieSoft Book Reader has a companion dossier, a Behind the Scenes / Bonus Feature card appears at the end of the chapter. Selecting it opens the dossier right inside your reading view without losing your spot—or you can explore the complete archive directly here on RaggieSoft Backstage.

Yes! Select Install App in the top bar (or Share → Add to Home Screen on mobile devices) to install RaggieSoft Backstage alongside RaggieSoft Book Reader and The Listening Room with offline access across all 68 records. Select Appearance at any time to switch between Light, Dark, or device-matched lighting, five distinct visual styles, and four editorial color palettes.
